evidence: Official Purdue GIS FID 942 names VA2 / Veterinary Animal Isolation Building 2 at 400 S University Street.
Fresh-open probe compared the exported foundation bounding box against all source polygon vertices after the documented coordinate conversion; maximum bound error was 0.00000067 m.
Feature global ID and BLDG_ABBR are preserved in evidence.json.
limits: GIS Shape__Area reports 838.125 m² while the source polygon coordinate-derived area is about 484.9 m²; area disagreement is unresolved.

evidence: Asset origin is the documented GIS bbox center (-201.1700, -948.4519) m in the campus frame.
Long north-south orientation and foundation dimensions match the GIS polygon to sub-millimetre bbox precision.

The outermost modeled envelope exceeds the GIS foundation bounds by up to about 0.20 m on each side, consistent with exterior louver/panel overhangs; campus-placement marker is not part of this isolated library asset.
limits: No on-campus linked placement was independently verified in the master blend during this isolated-asset grade.

criteria.criterion: Evidence-backed height, floors, and roof form
evidence: GIS lists one level; official Purdue OEP source describes two floors, with the second an HVAC interstitial and no basement. The asset presents a low occupied volume beneath one roofline.
Aerial evidence supports the long flat roof, central service strip, and rooftop equipment arrangement.
Fresh-open inspection confirms roof equipment is geometrically at roof level; sampled roof unit starts at z=4.617 m against roof plane about 4.62 m.
limits: Roof/parapet heights are estimates (4.62/4.87 m), not surveyed measurements. The source field conflict remains unresolved; rooftop unit count/type is only aerially inferred.

evidence: Exterior preview shows restrained long wall bands, high louver strips, sparse windows/doors and service-oriented detailing.
Official OEP page supports animal research/teaching use and a bathroom at one end, but does not disclose elevation details or which end.
limits: No reliable street-level facade image or elevation was available in evidence. Wall materials, colors, opening rhythm, precise entrances, and most facade details are interpretive rather than verified.

criteria.criterion: Modular export, portability, and complete evidence
evidence: Fresh Blender 5.2.3 process opened the saved .blend successfully and verified expected scene, building ID, and asset collection.
1,113 local mesh objects; 13 procedural materials; no file-image dependencies or linked external libraries.
Evidence folder records source URLs, retrieval dates, conversion, estimates, and uncertainty.
limits: The interior floor plan and animal-care equipment are explicitly illustrative, not a claim of the real plan.

findings.finding: GIS Shape__Area is 838.125 m², but the polygon coordinates produce approximately 484.9 m² area (bbox approx 527 m²). Model follows the polygon vertices and must not be considered area-validated until the provider discrepancy is resolved.

preview_interior_cutaway.png shows rooftop service units and wall fragments floating above/behind the cutaway. The cutaway script hides selected roof/wall shells only for rendering and leaves related explanatory geometry visible. This is a cutaway-preview artifact; fresh-open saved asset and exterior preview show rooftop objects seated at roof height. Do not treat the cutaway as a faithful assembly view.
Facade elevations, measured height, precise HVAC specification, and room plan are not evidenced. Interior layout is a visualization inferred from the published facility use.
